html:
luiskr.com

luiskr.com / experiments/star-field/engine/spiral/fill / fillElliptical

function fillElliptical(pos, col, radius, seed, count, tint, i0?, i1?): void

Defined in: experiments/star-field/engine/spiral/fill.ts:322

Fills the buffers for an elliptical dwarf galaxy — no spiral structure, just a smooth spheroid of old stars: a gaussian radial profile (dense core, exponential fall-off) over uniform directions, flattened on Y so the smudge reads as a dE/dSph rather than a ball. The tint hex steers the vertex ramp so spheroidals glow warm and irregulars read cooler.

Parameters

pos

Float32Array

Float32 xyz buffer — indexes [i0·3, i1·3) are written.

col

Float32Array

Float32 rgb buffer (same range).

radius

number

Body radius in scene units.

seed

number

Body seed — per-point Fibonacci-hashed LCG (chunkable).

count

number

Point count to fill.

tint

[number, number, number]

RGB multiplier tint (from def.color channel components).

i0?

number = 0

First point index of this range (0 for the local fill).

i1?

number = count

One past the last point index (count for the local fill).

Returns

void
